origin.claim: The same bias that overprices longshots underprices near-certain outcomes; buying NO at 90c+ YES prices collects a small premium with a large loss tail.

rules.entry: YES mid >= 0.90, spread <= 3 cents, closes within 48 hours.
rules.sizing: Target notional, capped by verified resting depth.

thesis: Buy NO where YES is already at or above 90 cents and the contract closes within two days. This is the mirror image of the longshot fade: it wins often and loses big occasionally, which is exactly the return profile a highest-return-only competition is allowed to take.
what_it_means: No trade has been placed yet. The strategy is live and evaluating Kalshi event contract markets every tick.
